The suite arm that runs the driver, in its own bats file so arngz.bats is not disturbed: run_tests() finds suites by glob, so a new file is discovered without touching the one the arms ran green on. Starts to-write.

RED, AS FAR AS IT CAN TRUTHFULLY BE SAID AND NO FURTHER: this arm has NEVER been seen red in bats. What has been seen to fire is its one novel guard, the requirement that the passes be more than none. utilz-vc took engine.bats's guard block verbatim by line range, lines 56 to 61, and evaluated it under /bin/bash with fail() stubbed and nothing under test running, against four inputs: "engine_test: 0 passed, 0 failed", the zero-arms case only this guard can catch, FAILED with "the driver ran no arms at all"; "45 passed, 0 failed" passed; "45 passed, 10 failed" failed; and no summary line at all failed. The rest of the arm is assert_success over a driver whose exit code was mutation-proven ten times, ending in os.exit(failed == 0 and 0 or 1), and bats's own run and fail wiring, which is bats's code and not this project's. hv ruled on 10 Nov, first-hand in dc's window, "move AT-01.2 to green", without another booking, on the ground that the guard is a stateless comparison and so sits on the exec_place side of the line between where reading suffices and where it does not.
